- In-house design capability in power electronics, built by investing in skilling manpower for product design after the legacy voice platform business was closed
- Designed a 1500-watt EV charger described in the Directors' Report as a rare Designed in India and Made in India product, with lab testing complete
- Positioned as a secondary vendor to defence contractors for customised battery charging solutions
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Legacy business closed as unviable — The Company's earlier business of providing IoT platforms for enterprise voice and integration with video cloud to global telecom service providers became unviable and was closed effective March 31, 2025, removing the established revenue base.
- Wholesale change in the nature of the business — The Directors' Report records a major change in the nature of the business during the year under review, with the Company now focusing on becoming an original design house in power electronics and related fields — an unproven activity for it.
- New business is pre-revenue and dependent on R&D paying off — Management states only that it is very hopeful the investments in R&D in power electronics shall start yielding revenue going ahead; no revenue from the new activity is asserted.
- Product not yet commercialised; no OEM partner secured — Lab testing of the 1500-watt EV charger is complete, but field testing is still pending and the Company is only scouting for OEMs in India to collaborate for go-to-market, so commercialisation depends on partners not yet named.
- Long defence development lead time and secondary-vendor position — The Company works as a secondary vendor to defence contractors rather than contracting directly, and expects only to demonstrate prototypes of customised battery charging solutions in the next 18 months.
- IoT software platform still at proof-of-concept stage — The integrated software platform for IoT for connected consumer durable appliances, intended to be sold on project and annuity basis, is only at an advanced stage of demonstrating a proof of concept.

outlook.body: The Directors' Report describes no plant, capacity or rupee capex programme; expansion is asset-light and design/R&D-led. Having closed the voice platform business, the Company invested in skilling manpower for the development of product designs in power electronics, and designed a 1500-watt EV charger described as a rare Designed in India and Made in India product. Lab testing of that product is complete and the Company is scouting for OEMs in India to collaborate for its go-to-market after field testing. In parallel it is working as a secondary vendor to defence contractors on customised battery charging solutions, with prototypes expected to be demonstrated in the next 18 months, and is at an advanced stage of demonstrating a proof of concept for an integrated software platform, on project and annuity basis, for IoT for connected consumer durable appliances.
